incidents.name: Inverse Finance anYvCrv3Crypto LP oracle manipulation
incidents.notes: The anYvCrv3Crypto market priced its yvCurve-3Crypto collateral from the Curve tricrypto pool's live composition, so a flash-loaned WBTC/USDT imbalance lifted the LP price and let the attacker borrow out the DOLA reserves; the market itself worked as written.

sources.ref: onchain review: anYvCrv3Crypto 0x1429a930ec3bcf5Aa32EF298ccc5aB09836EF587 created 2022-05-24T22:20:45Z by 0xc253af7b80f3dd3d469bf4b94aa9e3df59e71e43, unrelated to the attack sender 0x7b792e49...; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (22.4 days). The PoC gives no attack tx; the recorded hash was matched to the incident by checking it lands in block 14972419 on 2022-06-16, the date of the Frontier oracle exploit, and calls the attacker contract 0xf508c58ce37ce40a40997C715075172691F92e2D. Loss ~$1.26M in DOLA as reported by Inverse Finance.
